content:
Hi all, I am busy provisioning more resources for CI (and fixing some bugs in how we dispatch jobs, oops), but it is also clear that we need more CI runners. The FRO is willing to pay for more, and there are plans that will hopefully recruit more resources for this on a >1 month timescale, but if anyone has server resources they are willing to provide in the short term, please let me know. (64gb ram is realistically a prerequisite for running multiple CI jobs, and the more cores the better.)

(If anyone wants to think through how our current CI works, and give high quality advice about making it more efficient, please let me know.)
I have a server which we could use. It's got 128gb of ram and 32 cores.
On my grant I'll soonish also have a dedicated beefy computer with more like 512gb of ram which we can use as well.
My maths dept has a 500gb ram 64 cores machine. I could ask the IT guy if we can run some CI jobs on it.
@Kim Morrison, IT guy is game. If you tell me how, I will set the big maths dept computer up as a CI runner.

Just a comment but… how expensive is CI compared to running a reviewer now? (and how likely is it for reviewer to complain?)
If (somehow?) CI becomes more expensive than reviewer, we may consider running reviewer on a fraction of jobs for A/B testing… one possible advantage is if reviewer is happy before any CI is run, we may only need to run CI once instead of twice.
